blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will head to North Seymour. The island was formed from underwater volcanic lava during an eruption around 3.1 million years ago. It is home to land iguanas, blue-footed boobies, gulls and great frigatebirds.

After a morning on the island, you will return to the yacht for lunch.

In the afternoon, a landing on Mosquera is planned. It has one of the largest sea lion colonies in the Galapagos. Migrating orcas can sometimes be seen near the island.

At sunset, you will return to the Aqua Mare yacht for your final evening on board. Choose a wine from the wine list and share memories of the past week with your fellow guests.
